description:
FOUND s506f (Opus, 2026-10-04) attributing the one-liner battery's misses (ol-062/ol-064,
`perl -Mbignum=bpi -le 'print bpi(n)'`, perl1line.txt).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL 618db500 / s506f):
  perl -e 'sub foo { "[$_[0]]" } print foo(n), "\n";'   -> [n]
  pcl  -e 'sub foo { "[$_[0]]" } print foo(n), "\n";'   -> dies: Undefined subroutine &main::n called
                                                           (inside SBCL's "While evaluating the form" wrapper, #2492)
perl's rule: under `no strict 'subs'`, a bareword that is not a known sub, filehandle or class and is
not followed by `(` is a STRING.  PCL calls it.  (#266's callable classifier is the family: "a bare
NAME is a CALL only where it is CALLABLE"; here the name is not declared anywhere.)  Under
`use strict` perl refuses it at compile time ("Bareword "n" not allowed while "strict subs" in use").
Two battery one-liners (ol-062 bpi(n), ol-064 bexp(1,n+1)).


=== DONE (s508a) ===
Without strict subs, the SOLE argument of a parenthesised sub/method call that nothing makes callable is the third `p-bareword-value` site (the image is asked: a sub if one exists at run time, else the TEXT); a registered handle name as a whole element of a user call's argument list is its text.  Commits 788a22b8 + ef20792d (the mark rides on a FRESH token) + 9c68fea7 (s510: a perl KEYWORD callee -- `pipe(R, W)`, in no parameter table -- is no sub call; the first cut turned W into the string "W" and io/pipe.t / op/fork.t lost their pipe; bisected to 788a22b8; method names are exempt from the keyword test).  ir-spec §1.
Guards bareword-call-01.t rows 44 (fails on the base), 45, 46 (negatives), 47 (pipe; the unfixed tree prints "no handle").
OPEN RESIDUE, keeps today's call on purpose: (1) a bareword argument to a BUILTIN callee (`lc(ABC)`, `length(abc)`) -- perl gives the string, PCL calls and dies; (2) a sub that only a RUN-TIME glob assignment creates (`*rt = sub {...}; foo(rt)`) -- perl gives "rt", PCL calls it.  Under `use strict` nothing changed (k21/k22 emission identical to the base).
Review probe kw.pl (s510, 35 rows by kind of callee): the tree differs from perl on 6 rows, all 6 also differ on main -- rows 21, 22, 24, 32 are residue (1) above (`length(abc)`, `uc(abc)`, `ref(abc)`, `show(uc(abc))` die "Undefined subroutine &main::abc"); rows 15 (`$o->open(zz, yy)`) and 30 (`require(File::Basename)`) filed as #2782.

Companion (--all --quick, on b88a599a) and board (0 NEW / 0 FIXED / 0 LOST, 1827 = 1827) in the s508a session-log section; final bars there.
subject: without `use strict`, an undeclared bareword used as an ARGUMENT (`foo(n)`, `bpi(n)`) is called as a sub and dies "Undefined subroutine &main::n"; perl passes the string "n"
